description: NaHo₂F₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.53 Å. There are two inequivalent Ho sites. In the first Ho site, Ho is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Ho-F bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.57 Å. In the second Ho site, Ho is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Ho-F bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.50 Å. There are seven inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ho atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three Ho atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two Ho atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ho atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ho atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Ho atoms. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ho atom.
